title: Fatima Jaiyan Veeraan Diyan Laashan Tay Ro Vain Paundiyan
body:
Veerna Haye Veerna, Jay Rassiyan Na Paundiyan, Teri Turbat Banaundiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch Log Shaam Walay, Meray Ghar Nu Jalanaday Nay,
Nanay Day Kalma Go Paye, Sir Nangey Turaanday Nay,
Pathran Haye Pathran, Diyan Baarishaan’ch Behna,
Tera Abid Bachaundiyan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Aasray Tay Ghazi, Pardes May Vasaya
Vaaja Vi Maariya Main, Ro Ro Kay Mai Bulaya
Sogaya Haye Sogaya, Dariya Te Kanday Jaa Kay,
Tenu Keevein Uthaandiyan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadon Puchiya Sitamgaaran, Kayri Ali Di Dhee Ay
Rath Paak Muhaari Di, Akhiyan’ch Dull Payi Ay
Maa Fizza Haye Tu Dissa, Fizza Day Kand Day Aulay,
Rayi Athru Vagaundiyan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbaar Waali Payshi, Zainab Nu Maar Gayi Ay,
Nanay Day Deen To Haye, Jeray Bachrey Vaar Gayi Ay,
Baykhataa Haye Baykhataa, Na Mehraman Day Kolon,
Rayan Jhirkan Nay Khaundiyan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chan Peer Day Malang Paye, Akbar Da Nauha Parday
Kul Ambiya Vi Matam, Asghar Day Naal Karday
Ayna Layee Haye Ayna Layee, Bibi Diyan Duawan,
Arshaan Toun Aundiyan.
